name: Wiscon Industries
summary: Wiscon Industries is a Delhi-based company, incorporated in September 2022, that trades and distributes LED TVs, air coolers, washing machines and ACs under its own Wiscon brand and sells third-party electric scooters; it recently acquired LED TV maker Dalmia Technologies as a wholly owned subsidiary. Consolidated revenue jumped from ₹3.2 cr in FY24 and ₹14.5 cr in FY25 to ₹196.9 cr in FY26, with profit of ₹20.4 cr in FY26, but most of that jump comes from the acquired subsidiary and operating cash flow was negative ₹20 cr in FY26. Of the ₹88 cr fresh issue, only ₹15 cr (17%) funds new machinery while ₹52 cr goes to working capital; promoter Sidhant Dalmia also sells ₹22 cr through the offer for sale. At the upper band the post-issue P/E on FY26 profit is about 20x, roughly 26% above the only listed peer named in the RHP, Cellecor Gadgets.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Consolidated revenue rose from ₹3.21 cr (FY24) to ₹196.87 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 683%, largely from the acquired subsidiary.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹3.21 cr, ₹14.49 cr, ₹196.87 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was 0.96 at June 2026 (borrowings ₹36.97 cr vs net worth ₹38.49 cr), up from 0.83 in FY26.

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings and revenue on the same (consolidated) basis across FY24–FY26 were not found in public sources.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: about −₹0.34 cr (FY24), ₹4.17 cr (FY25), ₹30.61 cr (FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow was negative at −₹20.01 cr in FY26, against a profit of ₹20.41 cr.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax rose from ₹1.25 cr in FY25 to ₹20.41 cr in FY26, helped by the subsidiary acquisition.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: Net margin improved from a loss in FY24 to about 8.6% (FY25) and 10.36% (FY26).

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: Return on net worth was 66.67% in FY26, on a small equity base.

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 51.82% in FY26.

checks.name: Margin vs listed peers
checks.finding: FY26 net margin of 10.36% vs about 3.1% for the only listed peer, Cellecor Gadgets (₹39.61 cr profit on ₹1,292 cr revenue).

checks.name: P/E vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue P/E of about 20.0x on FY26 profit (₹407.75 cr market cap / ₹20.41 cr) vs 15.89x for the only peer, Cellecor Gadgets, about 26% above.
